privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How Tasami collects, uses, and protects your information.
privacy.intro: Tasami ("we", "us", "our") provides government and technology services to businesses and individuals in Saudi Arabia. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, why we collect it, and how we handle it when you use our website, WhatsApp channels, or Monjez assistant.

s1.title: 1. Information We Collect
s1.body: We collect information you provide directly — such as your name, mobile number, email, national ID or commercial registration details, and any documents you share when requesting a service. We also collect basic technical data (device, browser, and usage patterns) to keep the platform secure and improve performance.

s2.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
s2.body: We use your information to process service requests, communicate updates via WhatsApp, email, or Monjez, verify your identity where required by law, and improve the quality and speed of our services. We do not sell your personal data to third parties.

s3.title: 3. Sharing With Official Platforms & Partners
s3.body: To complete government transactions, we may submit your information to official Saudi platforms (such as Absher, Qiwa, or Najiz) or licensed authorized agents acting on your behalf, strictly for the purpose of fulfilling your request and in line with applicable regulations.

s4.title: 4. Data Security & Retention
s4.body: We apply reasonable technical and organizational safeguards to protect your data against unauthorized access, loss, or misuse. We retain information only for as long as necessary to deliver our services and meet legal or regulatory obligations.

s5.title: 5. Your Rights & Contact
s5.body: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information at any time by contacting us via WhatsApp or email below. We will respond to reasonable requests within a reasonable timeframe.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.subtitle: The terms that govern your use of Tasami's services.
terms.intro: These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your access to and use of the Tasami website, WhatsApp channels, and Monjez assistant. By requesting a service or using our platform, you agree to these Terms.

s1.title: 1. Scope of Services
s1.body: Tasami facilitates government transactions and technology solutions on your behalf, either directly or through licensed authorized agents and official Saudi platforms. Availability, processing time, and requirements for each service depend on the relevant government or technical authority and may change without prior notice.

s2.title: 2. Client Responsibilities
s2.body: You are responsible for providing accurate, complete, and up-to-date information and documents. Delays, rejections, or additional fees resulting from incorrect or incomplete information provided by you are not the responsibility of Tasami.

s3.title: 3. Fees & Payment
s3.body: Service fees, where applicable, are communicated transparently before work begins, either via WhatsApp, Monjez, or our secretary team. Government fees, third-party charges, and taxes are separate from our service fees and are your responsibility.

s4.title: 4. Service Delivery & Timelines
s4.body: We aim to keep you informed at every stage of your request through your preferred channel. Estimated timelines are provided in good faith but are not guaranteed, as many transactions depend on external government or technical systems outside our control.

s5.title: 5. Limitation of Liability & Governing Law
s5.body: Tasami is not liable for delays, losses, or damages arising from circumstances beyond our reasonable control, including outages or changes at official government platforms. These Terms are governed by the laws of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and any dispute shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of its competent courts.
